changeinfo.changes:
• Added dateable characters.
  • Added character dialogues.
  • Improved game stability.

• Adjusted game balance.
  • Added new dungeon content.
  • Improved gameplay.
  • Added sacraments, a new equipment type.
  • Added additional weapon transformations.
  • Added option to set party size for raids.
  • The smithy has been updated.
  • The LOG OUT feature inside the menu now allows you to end the online game.
  • Level 75 cap has been unlocked.
  • Save data version has been updated.
  • Previous game version will no longer be able to load the updated save data.
  • Network version has been updated.
  • Unable to connect to player with a different version.
  • Improved game stability.

• Added main story quest "Warriors of the Sky."
  • Added new characters: Rain and Seven.
  • Added a new stage.
  • Added new Sacrament Invasion dungeon.
  • You can now warp to dungeon entrances using the dungeon's Teleportation Stone.
  • You can now check the dungeon version and its cleared status via Map.
  • A shady merchant can now be found at Teleport Gate Plaza.
  • Gold Pieces which are used to exchange for special items with the Shady Merchant is now obtainable via Experience Chain Bonus.
  • Successful SSC hit will no longer be interruptable even after step.
  • Level 80 cap has been unlocked.
  • Added Experience Chain Bonus system.
  • Added items that increases stats.
  • Debuffs durations are now reduced according to VIT stats.
  • Critical chance, attack speed, and backstab damage now increase according to DEX stats.
  • Accuracy, movement speed, and weight reduction buffs now increase according to AGI stats.
  • Storage slots increased to 1000.
  • Blacksmith's upper limit stats updated.
  • The Affection System has been updated, and new features have been added.
  • Added Online Duel Mode.
  • Duel Mode palette will be available for setup now.
  • Drop rates have been increased during multiplayer to account for game difficulty and number of players.
  • Multiplayer can now be accessed from Teleport Gate Plaza.
  • Room purpose can now be specified when searching for a multiplayer room.
  • You can now exclude rooms with passwords when searching for a party online.
  • Network version has been updated.
  • Unable to connect to player with a different version.
  • Save data version has been updated.
  • Previous game version will no longer be able to load the updated save data.
  • Improved game stability.
